div.head: VI Atr 53
div.ab: Ælce dæde toscade man wærlic ⁊ a dom be dæde fadige mid rihte ⁊ medemige be mæþe for Gode ⁊ for worolde; ⁊ miltsige man for Godes ege ⁊ liþige man georne ⁊ beorge be dæle þam þe þæs þearf sy; forþam ealle we beþurfan þæt us ure Drihten oft ⁊ gelome his miltse geunne. Amen.

Careful discrimination shall be made in judging every deed, and the judgment shall always be ordered with justice, according to the nature of the deed, and meted out in proportion, in affairs both religious and secular; and, through the fear of God, mercy and leniency and some measure of forbearance shall be shown towards those who have need of them. For all of us have need that our Lord grant us his mercy frequently and often. Amen.
